XERJ PACKS

XERJ Packs

One binary. One MCP registration. The catalog groups the tools your installed build actually serves.

Run xerj tools list or xerj tools list --json. The command uses the same specifications as MCP tools/list, so counts and capability status cannot drift from the server.

WritingOutline, section and review workflow. BioIdentity-scoped evidence for biographical claims. CyberAuthorized, scope-bounded security workflows.

Core and Hub

Core contains search, memory, graph, map, planning and feedback tools. Hub contains the signed Corpus Hub tools when the installed build has the required verification key.

Honest status

Empty packs remain visible in the catalog. Writing, Bio and Cyber are planned until xerj tools list reports their tools in the installed release. A site page is a workflow description, not a claim that a tool is available.
